Connected components

Source: R/net.R
ntcmp.Rd

Weak components join nodes linked by edges in either direction; strong components (Tarjan's algorithm, without recursion) join nodes that reach each other along the edges' directions. Undirected, the two coincide. Components are numbered 1, 2, ... in the order of their first node. Graph rules as in ntdeg().

Usage

ntcmp(from, to, nodes = NULL, dir = FALSE)

Arguments

from, to

Labels of the two ends of each edge: vectors of the same length (zero when nodes gives every node) with no missing values.

nodes

NULL, or every node's label once: the node order of the results and the way to include isolated nodes.

dir

TRUE for a directed graph (from sends a tie to to).

Value

A data frame: node, weak, strong.

References

Tarjan, R. (1972). Depth-first search and linear graph algorithms. SIAM Journal on Computing, 1(2), 146-160. doi:10.1137/0201010

Examples

ntcmp(c("a", "b", "c", "x"), c("b", "c", "a", "y"), dir = TRUE)
#>   node weak strong
#> 1    a    1      1
#> 2    b    1      1
#> 3    c    1      1
#> 4    x    2      2
#> 5    y    2      3
